pages.title: Storage
pages.text: This section provides information about $(thing)storage methods$() in $(item)Simply Journey$().

Crouch Right Click the $(item)Cardboard Box$() onto any tile entity, such as $(item)Chests$(), $(item)Furnaces$() and $(item)Spawners$(). $(br2)Break the box using an $(item)Axe$() or your hand fingers. $(br2)Crouch Right Click to remove the box.

$(item)Backpack$() you can place in world, color in different color combinations, upgrade with more inventory and enhance with many functional upgrades. $(br2)Can be accessed using a key press $(bold)'B'$(). $(br2)When in world player can use it the same way they would use a chest.
There are $(bold)5 tiers$() - leather, iron, gold, diamond, netherite. $(br2)Each of the tiers adds more storage slots and more upgrade slots.
The basic $(item)upgrade base$(). $(br2)It can be crafted into different upgrades, up to your choice. Check out more in $(item)JEI$().

pages.title: Expanded Storage
pages.text: This section expand the storage tiers with $(item)Expanded Storage$(). It adds tiered $(thing)Chests$(), $(thing)Classic Chests$(), $(thing)Barrels$(), and $(thing)Mini Storage$() blocks, from wooden all the way up to netherite.

pages.title: Tier Capacity
pages.text: Every tier stores more than the last:$(br2)$(li)Wooden - 27 stacks (vanilla)$(li)Copper - 45 stacks$(li)Iron - 54 stacks$(li)Golden - 81 stacks$(li)Diamond - 108 stacks$(li)Obsidian - 108 stacks, blast-proof$(li)Netherite - 135 stacks, blast-proof and fire-resistant

pages.title: Chests
pages.text: $(item)Chests$() behave like vanilla chests but can $(bold)merge along any axis$() - side by side, front to back, or stacked tall - instead of only forming a long double chest.$(br2)Wooden tier also comes in themed variants: Pumpkin, Present, Bamboo, and Moss.

pages.title: Classic Chests
pages.text: $(item)Old Chests$() hold the same capacity as regular chests but occupy the whole block and skip the opening animation entirely - a good pick for big storage rooms since it costs less FPS.

pages.title: Barrels
pages.text: $(item)Barrels$() work exactly like vanilla barrels, just with more inventory space per tier. $(br2)$(bold)Golden$() barrels/chests are liked by piglins, so nearby piglins won't attack when you open one.

pages.title: Mini Storage
pages.text: $(item)Mini Chests$() and $(item)Mini Barrels$() share the same tier lineup but only hold $(bold)1 stack$(). Great for gifting an item to another player or labeling a single-resource pickup point on a farm.

pages.title: Storage Mutator
pages.text: A tool with 4 modes for managing containers in-world without breaking them:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Merge$() - combine two adjacent chests into a double chest$(li)$(bold)Split$() - break a double chest back into singles$(li)$(bold)Rotate$() - rotate a storage block$(li)$(bold)Swap Theme$() - change the container's theme within the same tier$(br2)Tip: rename the tool to "Sparrow" in an anvil to unlock extra mini storage styles.

pages.title: Conversion Kits
pages.text: $(item)Conversion Kits$() upgrade an already-placed chest or barrel to the next tier $(bold)without losing its contents$() - no need to empty and rebuild your storage room just to raise capacity.
